recipes.name: Beast's Draught
recipes.description:
A draught with an offensive function.

- Usage: Gain the following effects

- Effects:
   Extra AP Against Monsters +15
   Combat EXP +20%
   Skill EXP +10%
   Recover 3 HP on Hits
   Monster Damage Reduction Rate +10%
   Critical Hit +3
   Weight Limit +100 LT

- Duration: 20 min
- Cooldown: 10 sec

※ Type: Draught
※ Only the effects of the last draught used will be applied.
※ Draught effects do not stack with other elixir/draught effects, except with perfumes, Whale Tendon Elixir, and Tough Whale Tendon Elixir.

- How to Obtain: Processing ({KeyBind:Manufacture}) - Simple Alchemy with the following materials 

- Materials:
Grim Reaper's Elixir x3
EXP Elixir x3
Elixir of Will x3
Tears of the Falling Moon x1

※ Higher grade versions of the same elixir can be used as a substitute at a 1:3 ratio.
